title: fix(fields): a multi-record lookup column in the line-item grid reads its records, not "undefined", read-only and in list mode
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ852pUyi6G1KDP9T8JogHTeb)_

Fixes #36618

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在只读的记录页、打印页或卡片式明细里查看明细行时，"可选多条关联记录"的那一列不再显示 undefined，而是逐个显示所关联记录的名称；单选的关联列外观不变。
- 属于体验专题的界面缺陷修复，替查看订单、报价这类带明细行单据的人解决看不懂的问题。
- 出错的话只是这一列显示不对，不影响保存的数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The line-item grid renders a read-only `LookupField` at two sites: the read-only table (`readonly` grid: read-only record page, print page) and the list form-factor cell (`displayMode="list"`). Both built the lookup's `field` without the column's `multiple`, while the editable cell passes `multiple: c.multiple`. Without it, `LookupField` resolves the stored id list as ONE id (`selectedOptions = [resolveSelectedOption(value)]`) and its single-value read-only face prints that option's missing label, which renders as "undefined".

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx`: both read-only sites now pass `multiple: c.multiple`, read from the column definition (as the card asks), never inferred from the value's shape. The read-only face then draws one badge per related record.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/fields` patch.

No new prop, key or export. Single-record lookup columns are unchanged.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.multiLookupReadonly-36618.test.tsx`, one case per site plus a control per site:

- read-only table: a cell holding `['p1', 'p2']` draws `Widget` and `Gadget`, and the grid's text has no `undefined`;
- list mode: the same;
- control, each site: a single-record lookup column still draws its one name.

Reverse verification (fix committed first; each site reverted on its own with an anchored replacement whose hit count was checked, test run, then `git checkout HEAD --` and `git diff HEAD` empty):

| Site reverted | Result |
|---|---|
| read-only table | `× read-only: a cell holding two product ids draws both product names`; 3 others pass |
| list mode | `× list: a cell holding two product ids draws both product names`; 3 others pass |

So each multi-value case pins its own site, and the controls pass both ways.

## Acceptance notes

- Not measured in a browser: the showcase app has no line-item grid with a multi-record lookup column to open. The jsdom pins render the real `LookupField` against a data source and read the drawn names.
- An empty stored list (`[]`) still reaches the lookup branch in both sites (the guard checks `null` and `''` only); with `multiple` passed it draws the lookup's read-only empty face, not the grid's muted em dash. Not pinned here, and what it drew before was not measured. Left as is: the card asks only for `multiple`.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx`, the two read-only `LookupField` sites (the only code change).
2. The new test file.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.multiLookupReadonly-36618.test.tsx` shows 4 passing; revert either `multiple: c.multiple` and its site's multi-value case fails.
